_comment: Real-world NFL stat correlation targets, measured from nflverse-data (github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data: player_stats, stats_team, schedules releases), 2021-2025 regular seasons. Not consumed by any code yet -- a diagnosis-task deliverable (measurement only, no sim changes) for comparing against engine/sim/draws.ts's realized correlations. DraftKings Classic (full-PPR) fantasy points computed from raw counting stats, not nflverse's own fantasy_points_ppr column (which uses a different -2 INT / -2 fumble-lost / no-yardage-bonus formula). Team roles (QB1/RB1/WR1/WR2/TE1) ranked per team per week by SEASON-TO-DATE cumulative volume (attempts for QB1, carries for RB1, targets for WR1/WR2/TE1) from STRICTLY PRIOR weeks of that same season -- not that week's own volume and not that week's points -- so a role reflects who the team's established starter already was entering the game, not who happened to get usage (or score) in the very game being correlated. A player only qualifies for a role once their prior-weeks cumulative volume is > 0, which structurally excludes week 1 of every season (no season-to-date history yet) from every role-based pair; DST has no such dependency (it's a team-week stat, not a ranked role) so DST-only pairs keep week 1. This replaces an EARLIER version of this file (ranked by that week's own volume, a lookahead/circularity bug this task's own prompt called out) -- every real_r below changed; sim_r did not (engine/sim/draws.ts unchanged since that version, re-used rather than re-run). DST = that team's own defense/special-teams scoring (sacks, interceptions, fumble recoveries off the opponent, defensive + special-teams TDs, safeties, blocked kicks, tiered points-allowed bonus -- opponent's score in that game, via schedules' home_score/away_score). Opponent pairs join same-game rows on (season, week, opponent_team); each game contributes one row per team side (Pearson r is symmetric in the pair, so this doesn't bias the result, just doubles N). `n` is that pair's own available (season,week) sample after dropping any row missing either side's role. sim_r is engine/sim/draws.ts's drawSlateOutcomes realized Pearson r, measured on data/samples/DraftKings NFL DFS Projections -- Main Slate (6).csv (20,000 trials, all 20 teams pooled, roles by salary rank within each team) -- unchanged from the prior measurement.
